title: SentinelCareEnvelope
description: Sent to POST /v1/care-envelopes. ciphertext is a libsodium sealed box (base64, standard alphabet) of the canonical JSON of a doctor_payload, sealed to the organization's care-team public key; payload_sha256 is the hash of that plaintext. One envelope per recipient organization (care team and each consented emergency organization) (D-064, D-065).
